study_design: district-day matched case-control with temporal holdout

analysis_roles.primary: concurrent accumulation including the reported event day, variant primary_conf_ge_0.78, window chosen by development AUC
analysis_roles.co_primary: strictly antecedent accumulation ending the day before the reported event; bounds what could be known before failure
analysis_roles.secondary: conditional within-matched-set association, leave-one-year-out and spatial validation, season stratification, district-month aggregate correlation
analysis_roles.sensitivity: date confidence, date shifts, trigger inclusion, road obstructions, balanced source panel, strict matched sets
analysis_roles.not_reported: absolute risk, probability calibration and decision-curve net benefit are not identifiable from a matched case-control sample drawn from an inventory with unknown detection probability

window_definition.concurrent_incl_event_day: sums end on and include the reported event day
window_definition.strictly_antecedent_excl_event_day: sums end on the day before the reported event day

control_matching: same district, calendar month, and year
balanced_panel_rule: publishers with at least 30 canonical events on both sides of the development cut-off

strict_matched_sets.note: complete matched sets only; each control district-day used at most once

reporting_composition.interpretation: The development/temporal-test contrast is confounded with publisher turnover. Compare against the balanced_source_panel variant before attributing any difference to time.

inventory_descriptive.district_day_collapse_note: Canonical records are deduplicated report clusters, not verified distinct physical failures. Records sharing a district-day are collapsed to one case-day in the rainfall analysis.

secondary_district_month_association.interpretation: Aggregate association only. Confounded by reporting effort and by zero-event district-months; not a threshold and not a landslide trend.

limitations: Event dates are media-derived; accuracy was not reportable in the locked test set.
CHIRPS represents gridded precipitation, not a slope-level rain gauge measurement.
District means smooth local rainfall extremes and are not warning thresholds.
Media reporting and road-obstruction events can affect the case distribution.
Precision reflects the matched 1:5 sample, not population event prevalence.

The development and temporal-test periods draw on partly different publishers, so the temporal comparison is confounded with a change in the reporting instrument; see the balanced_source_panel variant and inventory_reporting_composition.csv.
Concurrent windows include the reported event day and may contain rain that fell after failure; the strictly antecedent co-primary result bounds the usable signal.
Some cases have no eligible matched control and some control district-days support more than one case; see rainfall_matching_diagnostics.json and the strict_matched_sets variant.
Control days may include unreported landslides, which biases discrimination toward the null.
Canonical records are deduplicated report clusters rather than verified distinct physical failures.
